不过各模式在所有时段皆投票认为低，其中 10/28 13–19 时欧洲 AI 模式与欧洲模式的 6 小时雨量分别为 18.4 毫米与 15.9 毫米，欧洲系集 24 小时雨量超过 50 毫米的概率为 14%，皆未达中。

en.text: The disruption risk over the next five days is Medium, mainly due to heavy rain and thunderstorms.
The airport forecast (TAF) reports heavy thunderstorms from 10/28 13:00 to 10/29 07:00 with visibility dropping to 2000–2800 m, meeting the Medium threshold.

However, the models vote Low across all periods; during 10/28 13:00–19:00, the European AI model and European model show 18.4 mm and 15.9 mm of rain in 6 hours respectively, and the European ensemble gives a 14% chance of 24-hour rainfall over 50 mm, all below Medium.
